general_rules.title: Postpone Irrigation
general_rules.advisory: Substantial rainfall expected (P50: {rain_p50} mm, P90: {rain_p90} mm). Withhold artificial irrigation to prevent waterlogging and nutrient leaching.
general_rules.reason: Predicted rainfall is sufficient for soil moisture retention.

general_rules.title: Schedule Light Irrigation
general_rules.advisory: Dry and warm conditions predicted (TMAX P50: {tmax_p50} °C, Rain P50: {rain_p50} mm). Apply light, scheduled irrigation to maintain root zone moisture.
general_rules.reason: Elevated evapotranspiration during warm dry periods increases crop water demand.

general_rules.title: Avoid Chemical Spraying
general_rules.advisory: Rainfall anticipated during the upcoming period. Postpone pesticide, fungicide, and foliar fertilizer sprays to prevent chemical wash-off.
general_rules.reason: Rainfall within 6 hours of chemical application reduces product efficacy and causes environmental runoff.

general_rules.title: Favorable Spraying Window
general_rules.advisory: Low probability of rainfall. Safe window for scheduled plant protection operations.
general_rules.reason: Clear skies and low precipitation risk support optimal foliar absorption.

general_rules.title: Delay Harvesting / Protect Threshed Grain
general_rules.advisory: Rainfall expected during harvest phase (Rain P50: {rain_p50} mm). Suspend harvesting or ensure threshed produce is stored in rain-proof shelters.
general_rules.reason: Wet weather during harvest increases seed sprouting, fungal rot, and grain discoloration.

general_rules.condition: tmax_p50 >= 33.0 and growth_stage in ['Flowering / Pollination', 'Fruit / Grain Filling']
general_rules.title: Mitigate Heat Stress During Critical Growth Phase
general_rules.advisory: High daytime temperatures (TMAX P50: {tmax_p50} °C). Maintain adequate soil moisture through micro-irrigation or mulching to cushion pollen viability.
general_rules.reason: Temperatures exceeding threshold during reproductive phase cause flower drop and reduced fruit set.

Rice.title: Ensure Proper Drainage in Nursery
Rice.advisory: Heavy rainfall expected during nursery/transplanting. Maintain drainage channels to avoid submergence of young paddy seedlings.
Rice.reason: Young rice nursery beds can suffer seedling rot under prolonged standing water.

Rice.title: Maintain Shallow Water Layer
Rice.advisory: Cool night temperatures expected (TMIN P50: {tmin_p50} °C). Maintain 5 cm standing water in paddy fields at night to buffer soil temperature.
Rice.reason: Water thermal capacity protects spikelet sterility caused by cold nighttime temperatures.

Maize.title: Clear Waterlogging in Maize Fields
Maize.advisory: Maize is highly sensitive to waterlogging. Ensure surplus water is drained rapidly from rows.
Maize.reason: Standing water for more than 24 hours causes oxygen starvation in maize root systems.

Tomato.title: High Late Blight Fungal Infection Risk
Tomato.advisory: Humid rainy weather creates optimal conditions for Late Blight (*Phytophthora infestans*). Inspect foliage and apply protective bio-pesticides or recommended fungicides when weather clears.
Tomato.reason: Combined high humidity and moderate temperatures accelerate spore germination on tomato leaves.

Potato.title: Suspend Potato Tuber Digging
Potato.advisory: Do not harvest wet potato fields. Allow soil to dry before digging to prevent tuber rot during storage.
Potato.reason: Wet soil adhering to potato tubers promotes bacterial soft rot.

Apple.condition: rain_p50 >= 10.0 and growth_stage in ['Flowering / Pollination', 'Fruit / Grain Filling']
Apple.title: Apple Scab Risk Alert
Apple.advisory: Extended leaf wetness expected. Monitor canopy for early apple scab lesions. Plan curative fungicide applications once rain subsides.
Apple.reason: Continuous wet leaf duration favors Venturia inaequalis infection.
